messages:
faye: following the postmortem, capturing the follow-ups for missing spans + aggregation drift + ETL lag. goal: assign owners, get short timelines, and define the safety checks before rollout.

omar: suggest we break into action buckets: instrumentation (spans), aggregation correctness, ETL throughput/backfill. i'll coordinate cross-team dependencies.

lee: i'll take instrumentation. plan: run targeted smoke on sample services (payments, search) for 72h, compare span coverage delta, and push a hotfix if SDK path is repro. target: draft findings by Tue lunchtime.

tara: aggregation owner here. root cause appears to be non-deterministic ordering in reduce step + null coalescing. i'll open a PR with deterministic group-sort and add property tests. aim: PR by Thu.

faye: @ops-bot please create three tickets and link to postmortem doc. include due dates and an "safety check" field.

ops-bot: tickets created: RW-3710-instr-audit (owner: lee), RW-3711-agg-fix (owner: tara), RW-3712-etl-backfill (owner: omar). Links: https://issues.redwood/RW-3710, https://issues.redwood/RW-3711, https://issues.redwood/RW-3712

omar: for ETL backfill, proposing a controlled catch-up: 8h/day with concurrency 4, with token bucket rate limit to keep latency under SLO. infra to approve.

infra-bot: quota check: current slot usage allows +2 workers in region us-west-2 between 02:00-10:00 UTC. request RW-3712 updated with windows.

lee: quick note from audit run: found SDK v1.13 flush path where cancellation could drop spans during shutdown. small repro (local):
```
# curl to trace endpoint to simulate burst
curl -s -X POST https://tracer.internal/v1/spans -d '{"spans": [..]}'
```
Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/912  fixes ordering, adds graceful drain.

tara: aggregation PR: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/201  added deterministic reduce and added randomized property tests to CI. also added a fallback to treat missing group keys as explicit empty string to avoid silent bucket merges.

faye: timeline recap in tickets: RW-3710 (lee) due 2512420000 (Tue EOD), RW-3711 (tara) due 2512590000 (Thu EOD), RW-3712 (omar) plan due 2512660000 (Mon am). please update tickets as you progress.

omar: infra approved the window; starting staged backfill tomorrow 03:00 UTC. i'll post a short progress update every 2h in this thread.

eng-sre: we'll add a pair of dashboard tiles: span_coverage_pct and aggregate_delta_score. also creating an alert: aggregate_delta_score > 0.2 for 10m -> runbook and paging.

lee: long-term prevention idea: add a lightweight "span shadowing" preflight job that mirrors SDK traces to a canary pipeline and compares counts before deploying SDK changes. adding to backlog RW-3760.

faye: agree on the prevention work. for now, rollouts should include canary against 1% traffic with the new telemetry SDK. add canary gate to deployment checklist.

tara: one more thing  added unit test showing previous aggregate failure on empty-key buckets; test included in PR. please review.

ops-bot: RW-3711  PR status: open -> awaiting-review. RW-3710  PR status: open -> tests-passing. RW-3712  plan updated with window 03:00-11:00 UTC.

faye: closing the follow-up thread for now. we'll reopen if backfill or PRs reveal additional edge cases. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
